hero.title: Get more out of your Atlassian tools.
hero.intro: Whether you're a software, service, or business team, there's a place for Atlassian to improve how you work together. We set your tools up so employees use them because they want to, not because they have to.

items.title: Context Architecture
items.text: Information architecture for the AI era. We connect and organize your work, knowledge, code, and data, so your people can find what they need and your AI agents can see it and act on it.

items.title: AI Optimization
items.text: Apply AI across the Atlassian ecosystem with Rovo, so your teams make better decisions and reach their goals faster.

items.title: Collaboration & Knowledge
items.text: Empower your team to share everything that matters, so knowledge compounds instead of getting lost.

items.title: Work Management
items.text: Unify your organization with tools that streamline project tracking and enhance information sharing across every team.

items.title: Enterprise Service Management
items.text: Formalize business processes with customer-friendly tools, using automation and AI to adapt as your needs evolve.

items.title: Digital Transformation & Cloud
items.text: A company-wide strategy for new habits, not just new tools, on a cloud-first architecture: seamless integration, strategic automation, robust security, and smooth migration.

cycle.title: Empower & amplify.
cycle.text: Our optimization cycle empowers your teams and amplifies their results through customized software development, training, and support.
